response.sql: SELECT player_id, SUM(triple) AS total_triples FROM batting_postseason WHERE league_id = 'NL' AND round = 'WS' GROUP BY player_id ORDER BY total_triples DESC NULLS LAST, player_id LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: 'NL and World Series' means rows with league_id = 'NL' and round = 'WS'. The totals sum only those rows.
Ties at the cutoff are broken by player_id, which the request does not specify. A player whose triple values are all NULL gets a NULL total and sorts last.

alternatives.interpretation: Select players who have at least one NL World Series batting record, then total their triples across all of their postseason batting records (every league and round).
alternatives.sql: SELECT player_id, SUM(triple) AS total_triples FROM batting_postseason WHERE player_id IN (SELECT player_id FROM batting_postseason WHERE league_id = 'NL' AND round = 'WS') GROUP BY player_id ORDER BY total_triples DESC NULLS LAST, player_id LIMIT 10
